classification: local release-fast benchmark on the development hub; not a production, fleet or freshness qualification
objective: profile and reduce the transparent v11 continuous publication cycle (production attempt14: serial cycles 23-25 s, burst block visibility 43-45 s against an unchanged 30 s target)

sources.benchmark: transparent/services/transparent-filter-server/examples/publication_bench.rs (identical in both builds; baseline binary built from the baseline's library sources plus this example)
sources.profile_binaries: baseline and final sources with instrument.py applied (temporary phase timers, never committed)

build.profile: release-fast (fat LTO off, codegen-units 16); no deploy artifact was built
build.command: tool-exec --repo wallet-pir -- cargo build --profile release-fast -p transparent-filter-server --example publication_bench
build.target_lane: task-owned CARGO_TARGET_DIR reused for every build

workload.derivation: v3 journal from height 3,000,000: one empty archive block, then consecutive copies of the day. Copy c>0 offsets txids and gives about 70% of supported scripts a per-copy identity; fees exact where every input value is known, otherwise unknown with shielded components; synthetic block hashes. Representative synthetic data derived from real data, not a production replay.

geometries.recent: recent-8k (8192 x 4096-byte rows per table) from 3,000,001

workload.seal_policy_recent: scripts target 407,260 capacity 475,136; page rows target 7,936 capacity 8,192
workload.cycle: append one block, Snapshot::capture, publication::publish into a new directory with --previous, ShardFilters::open (the controller's spawn_blocking publication and candidate read)
workload.runtime: TableRuntime::build for the final tail's directory and pages segments in the runtime build pool, TRANSPARENT_BUILD_THREADS=2 (a 4-vCPU worker's default), two repeats per run

commands.comparison: bench/compare.sh (alternates base and final twice per fill, three cycles each)
commands.retention_probe: cargo test --profile release-fast -p transparent-filter-server --lib -- --ignored --nocapture retention_scan_cost (three runs)
commands.focused_tests: cargo test --profile release-fast -p transparent-shard --lib; -p transparent-filter-server --lib -- publication; -p transparent-shard-server --lib -- runtime::tests

results: summary.json, runtime-stages.json, profile/, retention-probe.jsonl, row-stability.json, published-trees.json
failures_and_rejected: Reusing the previous tail revision's hint or rows: rejected; consecutive revisions share no nonzero row in either table (row-stability.json) because script tags are salted by the endpoint hash
Two-level free-space bitmap in the packer: measured 0.2-0.3 s at 97% fill, inside host noise; reverted
First packer equivalence test used an impossible out-of-row size that also divides by zero in the reference; corrected to an out-of-range free space
The first sealer fixture did not exercise closing before an over-capacity block that pages; a mutation removing the demand restore passed until the fixture was strengthened
